# Saydraft

> Speak messy. Paste polished. Local voice dictation for Windows, with local speech recognition, cleanup, and a searchable Hub. Open source under MIT; downloaded models and dependencies retain separate licenses.

Saydraft is in active development. Source setup is available; no installer release is published yet. Native/manual Windows acceptance, owner ASR accuracy acceptance, and several roadmap features remain open. Do not describe the project as complete parity or infer accuracy from its test counts.

## Source setup

Use Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit Python 3.13, Git, a microphone, and free disk space for selected models. In PowerShell:

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/tanzir71/saydraft.git
cd saydraft
py -3.13 -m venv .venv
.venv\Scripts\python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
.venv\Scripts\python -m saydraft
```

The legacy tools/build.ps1 awaits the P8 clean-environment rewrite; it is not the supported installation path. Development checks are in CONTRIBUTING.md and .github/workflows/ci.yml.

## Models and downloads

Fresh profiles recommend Parakeet v3 int8 with a language detector (773.4 MB combined). Parakeet v2 int8 is an English option (661.3 MB). Whisper base/small/medium are alternatives. The optional All languages Whisper large-v3-turbo model (1,621.7 MB) supports multilingual recognition, including Bengali and Arabic. Both languages share the same download; there are no separate language packs.

Setup shows model sizes and licenses before an explicit Download action, with progress and pause/resume. Selecting a language or model starts no transfer. Later launches reuse installed weights; language pins and automatic routing use compatible installed models. New installations use %LOCALAPPDATA%\Saydraft\models\<id>\<version>; compatible legacy models remain readable in place.

## First-run setup

The current wizard has five pages: Welcome, Microphone, Set up models, Hotkey, and Done. Refresh inputs explicitly discovers devices; Test input is a ten-second level-only check without transcription or saved audio. Check this PC produces a provisional capability recommendation, not a measured tier. Use speech recommendation stages the speech model without downloading or enabling AI cleanup.

Download / Resume is explicit. Setup checks installed pinned dependencies asynchronously and displays per-file transfer/checksum progress separately from whole-package verification. Finish merges changed microphone/model choices into the latest preferences; Cancel preserves saved preferences. Downloaded files are separate from preference saving. Finish can currently save with weights missing; actual dictation requires a compatible installed model.

The complete six-step flow, in-setup inference measurements/readiness gating, shortcut learning, a dedicated practice sandbox, Style quick pick, and final Hub Home handoff remain in development. See https://github.com/tanzir71/saydraft/blob/main/docs/ONBOARDING.md. Do not infer these features from the roadmap or an unconnected implementation component.

## Optional AI cleanup

Optional AI cleanup is disabled by default. Explicit setup offers pinned Qwen3.5 0.8B or 2B Q4_K_M with a local llama.cpp CPU or Vulkan runtime. Recommendations do not enable or download cleanup. Validated output can fall back to deterministic rules. See docs/MODELS.md, docs/ASR_ROUTING.md, and docs/CLEANUP_SETUP.md for requirements, measurements, and limits.

## App behavior

1. Hold Ctrl+Win to record; F9 and XButton1 are configurable alternatives. Ctrl+Win+Space toggles hands-free mode; two short recording-shortcut taps also lock it. Esc cancels.
2. Local Parakeet or Whisper transcribes; rules handle fillers, repetitions, self-corrections, punctuation, and lists. Optional local AI cleanup, per-app styles, Dictionary, and Snippets refine output.
3. History stores raw and cleaned text before attempted delivery into the original target. Focus changes, protected fields, and elevated targets can prevent delivery; saved text remains reviewable in History.
4. Shift+Alt+Z pastes the last dictation. F10 captures to History without foreground insertion. Fresh profiles warn at 19 minutes and cap recordings at 20; saved custom bindings/limits remain unchanged.

One Hub contains Home statistics/recent dictations, global History search/changes/export/retry, Dictionary, Snippets, Style, Notes, and Settings. Notes is currently a placeholder. Command, Translate, Ask, Scratchpad, and Notetaker remain roadmap work.

## Privacy and evidence

Dictation has no cloud fallback or telemetry. Audio retention is off by default; optional Keep forever / Keep N days policies preserve History text when eligible recordings expire. Retry requires retained audio. Python networking is restricted outside authorized model downloads and loopback. Complete native/helper-process firewall enforcement remains release work; the read-only firewall-rule check does not establish full coverage. See docs/PRIVACY.md.

The public website example is a canned simulation and requests no microphone access. Dated benchmark reports describe their recorded source/corpus, not automatic current-source or owner accuracy acceptance. Preserve historical report bytes and distinguish implementation from acceptance.
